text:
```yaml
name: Publish Fern Docs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Generate Fern docs
        run: cargo run --bin fern -- generate --docs --preview

      - name: Commit and push changes
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: 'docs'
          commit: 'Publish Fern docs'
          push: true
```
